description: This Java class defines a Liquibase database change set that moves 'deleted' HL7 message records from an archive table to a queue table within the OpenMRS system. It implements the CustomTaskChange interface to perform SQL operations for transferring and deleting records in the database.

classes.name: MoveDeletedHL7sChangeSet
classes.description: A class implementing CustomTaskChange to handle migration of deleted HL7 messages from archive to queue table.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the primary operation: moves deleted HL7 messages from archive to queue, then deletes from archive.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation message after completion.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets the resource accessor; no specific implementation needed here.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the change; returns an empty ValidationErrors object.
